site.trust.residency.title: Data residency
site.trust.residency.body: India and UAE run as separate deployments with separate keys, logs and backups.
site.trust.consent.title: Consent model
site.trust.consent.body: Treatment, recording, sharing, reminders and marketing are separate choices.
site.trust.ai.title: AI drafts
site.trust.ai.body: AI output is a draft until a licensed clinician reviews and signs it.
site.trust.retention.title: Retention
site.trust.retention.body: Audio kept 30 days by default; records per local medical rules.
site.trust.audit.title: Audit
site.trust.audit.body: Every access to a chart is logged and reviewable.
site.trust.subProcessors.title: Sub-processors
site.trust.subProcessors.body: Listed with region and purpose; changes announced 30 days ahead.
site.trust.footer: We describe our controls; we do not claim certifications we have not obtained. Policy versions and sub-processors are listed with dates.

site.notice.fields: Medvya collects these details from this form:
site.notice.purpose.demo: We use them only to contact you about a demo.
site.notice.purpose.waitlist: We use them only to tell you when Medvya opens in {region}.
site.notice.noSharing: We do not share or sell them, and we do not use them for anything else.
site.notice.retention: We keep them for 2 years after our last contact with you, then delete them.
site.notice.rights: To withdraw your consent at any time, or to see, correct or delete your details, email us at

site.notice.complain.AE: If you are not happy with our answer, you can complain to the UAE Data Office.

site.region.body: Your patients' data is stored and processed in this country. It cannot be moved to the other region later without a new account and export.

registration.full.intro.IN: Full registration: enter what the patient can provide now. ABHA is optional and care never depends on it.
registration.full.intro.AE: Full registration: copy the Emirates ID carefully to avoid typing errors.

registration.step.identity.title: Identity & identifiers
registration.step.contact.title: Contact & address
registration.step.payer.title: Payer

registration.step.identity.intro.IN: Enter what the patient can provide now. ABHA is optional.
registration.step.identity.intro.AE: Emirates ID or passport is required. An expired Emirates ID warns but never blocks care.
registration.step.contact.intro.IN: Indian address format with PIN code. The address is optional; without it the registration stays incomplete.
registration.step.contact.intro.AE: UAE address format. The emirate sets the health information exchange.
registration.step.payer.intro.IN: Self-pay is the default for most OPD visits. Leave it empty to add later.
registration.step.payer.intro.AE: Capture insurance card details for every insured patient. Leave it empty to add later.
registration.step.review.intro.IN: Confirm the details with the patient before saving.
registration.step.review.intro.AE: Confirm the details with the patient before saving.
registration.duplicates.inlineLater: Possible match · existing records that look like this patient: {n}. You decide about them on the Review step.
registration.preview.title: Preview
registration.map.title: Data map · this step writes
registration.map.identity: Name, date of birth, sex, language
registration.map.payer: Payer, plan, member number (encrypted), valid until
registration.map.audit: PatientRegistered.v1, no patient data in the event
registration.rules.title: Rules
registration.rules.minimumIN: Minimum to register: name, date of birth or age, sex, mobile.
registration.rules.phone: A phone number alone never matches records.
registration.rules.abha: ABHA is optional; care never depends on it.
registration.rules.aadhaar: Aadhaar: last 4 digits only, never the full number.
registration.rules.clinical: Registration screens never show clinical notes.
registration.rules.minimumAE: Minimum to register: name, date of birth, sex, mobile, Emirates ID or passport.
registration.rules.expired: An expired Emirates ID shows a warning; it does not block care.
registration.rules.arabic: The Arabic name is typed right to left.
registration.rules.hie: The emirate decides the health information exchange.
registration.rules.residency: UAE records never leave the UAE deployment.
registration.hint.dateOfBirth: If the date is unknown, record the age instead (marked estimated).
registration.verify.IN.title: Verify with ABHA · coming later.
registration.verify.IN.body: Scan & Share and OTP verification arrive with the ABDM connection. For now, type the ABHA number from the card.
registration.verify.AE.title: Read Emirates ID or verify with UAE PASS · coming later.
registration.verify.AE.body: The card reader and UAE PASS arrive later. For now, type the details from the card and confirm them against the person.
registration.hint.genderIdentity: Optional, and separate from sex at birth.
registration.hint.otherIdType: Full Aadhaar is never stored. Not required for care.
registration.warning.eidExpired: This Emirates ID has expired. You can still register the patient; ask them to renew it.
registration.hint.passport: Optional for residents with an Emirates ID.
registration.hint.address: Optional. Once any address field is filled, the rest of the address format applies.
registration.hint.emirate: Drives the HIE: Malaffi (Abu Dhabi), NABIDH (Dubai), Riayati (other emirates).
registration.hint.hieSelected: Health information exchange for this emirate: {hie}. No connection is made at registration.
registration.hint.payerKind: Without a payer the registration stays incomplete until one is added.
registration.hint.governmentScheme: For example AB PM-JAY, CGHS, ECHS or a state scheme. Recorded for reference only; eligibility and claims come in M4.
registration.payer.eligibility: Eligibility check: not checked. Real-time eligibility arrives in M4.
registration.payer.note: Billing data is never shown with clinical notes. Payment card numbers are not stored; payments go through the provider.
registration.review.name: Name
registration.done.warning.emirates_id.ex: The Emirates ID has expired. The patient is registered; ask them to renew it.
registration.done.warning.generic: Saved with a warning. Check the record.
registration.error.not_allowed: Choose a value from the list.
registration.error.emirates_id_or_passpo: Enter the Emirates ID, or a passport for visitors.
registration.error.aadhaar_full_number_n: Enter only the last 4 digits. The full Aadhaar number is never stored.
registration.error.format.Passport: Passport number: 6 to 20 letters and digits.
registration.state.Dadra and Nagar Havel: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
registration.error.nothing_to_complete: Add the address, the payer or the emergency contact.
patients.completion.title: Registration to complete
registration.complete.title: Complete registration
registration.complete.intro: Add what quick registration left out. The Incomplete registration tag goes once the address, the payer and an emergency contact are all recorded.
registration.complete.done.Complete: Registration complete. The completion task is closed.
registration.complete.done.Incomplete: Saved. The registration stays incomplete until the address, the payer and an emergency contact are all recorded.
registration.step.family.title: Family & emergency contact
registration.step.family.intro.IN: Emergency contact is required for full registration. A guardian is required when the patient is under 18.
registration.step.family.intro.AE: Emergency contact is required for full registration. A guardian or sponsor is needed for minors and dependants.
registration.hint.guardian.unknown: Becomes required when the patient is under 18.
registration.family.note: Emergency contacts are not given portal access. To let a family member see records, the patient authorises a caregiver proxy (R-04).
registration.error.required_for_minor: A guardian is required: the patient is under 18.
